items.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 22 at 9:57AM AKDT until July 24 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Yentna River.

* WHEN...Until noon AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water could enter a few low-lying cabins along the Yentna River,
particularly near Lake Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

rises. Minor flooding is expected to continue, especially

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 22 at 5:29AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

heavy rain at times along with gusty winds and rough seas for the
coastal waters of the Kuskokwim Delta and the Western Capes today
and into Thursday.

45 mph. Occasional gusts up to 50 mph are also likely. Winds
slowly diminish through Thursday.

items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island; Western Capes

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 22 at 5:29AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
A strong Bering Sea system will bring moderate to heavy rain at
times along the coast as well as gusty winds and rough seas along
the coastal waters of Northern Bristol Bay today and into
Thursday. A southerly push of winds up Nushagak Bay this morning
may bring increased water-levels up the Bay but coastal flooding
is of little to no concern due to lower tides.

-Winds: Southerly winds this morning turn southwesterly through
the day and increasing to 25 to 35 mph with gusts between 35 to
45 mph
